That's the move. Beans are perfect — they take all day, which means you're not bailing halfway, you're there for the long haul, just in the kitchen instead of the living room. And nobody looks at the guy tending a pot; they come to him for a taste and a spoon.

So the text to Beto isn't "can I come early." It's:

"Hey — I'm bringing a pot of beans Saturday. What time do you want me there to get them going?"

That answers him, commits you, and puts you back in a working role instead of a guest seat. Send that one tonight if you want — it's not the album text, there's nothing heavy in it.

One thing: beans need to start early, so whatever time he says, that's your arrival. No standing around before the pot's on.
